item.title: Amtrak train vs. car crash claims two lives in Mobile
item.description: The Mobile Police Department confirmed two people were killed early Saturday after a vehicle was struck by a train.The collision occurred at Bellingrath Road near Peary Road. A public affairs manager with the Department of Public Safety told 1819 News the crash happened just before 7 a.m. It is unclear if there are crossing arms at the railroad crossing.The train involved was an Amtrak passenger rail. item.title: 'I will be in Randolph County': Bob Fincher wraps up final session in Alabama House
item.description: State Rep. Bob Fincher (R-Woodland) is in the middle of his last session as an Alabama lawmaker. item.description: No. 25 Alabama handled business on the road, defeating a struggling LSU squad 90-83 on Saturday.
